hangzhou-11.bio: A seven-storey brick-and-wood pagoda above the Qiantang River, climbed for views of the river and its bridge.
hangzhou-11.ticket_note: No official site found; run by the West Lake scenic area's Qianjiang office (Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area); WeChat account only known
hangzhou-11.notes: 10 CNY tower ticket is from a 2011 Hangzhou news report quoting the scenic area office (stale); a Ctrip travel note mentions 20 CNY park entry plus 10 CNY tower. Current price unverified. Wikipedia EN has no article. Crowd-control may suspend tower entry (2025 report).

hangzhou-31.bio: A Y-shaped stream valley in the hills west of West Lake, known for its misty trees and a walk beside the brook.
hangzhou-31.ticket_note: Open scenic valley with no single operator
hangzhou-31.notes: Free per Ctrip page (open all day, weak) and visitor reviews; one 2022 ticket-agent page showing a price is a bundled product, ignored. Ctrip lists open year-round.

huzhou-6.bio: A silk-trade canal town of bridges and Ming-Qing merchant houses, free to stroll, with a few mansions charging entry.
huzhou-6.ticket_note: No official site found; Ctrip listings only
huzhou-6.notes: Old town free from a recent year per a Ctrip travel note (weak). Individual houses charge, e.g. Little Lotus Villa 25 CNY, Zhang Shiming residence 20 CNY (Ctrip, weak); not the spot's cost. Wiki article 'Nanxun' covers the town.

baishuichong-waterfall.bio: A 53 m waterfall near Liangnong in Yuyao, reached on foot from a free car park below Baishui Mountain.
baishuichong-waterfall.ticket_note: No operator or official site known
baishuichong-waterfall.notes: Location (Liangnong town, Yuyao, not Fenghua), 53 m drop and no ticket are from Ctrip travel notes and a search summary only (weak); the Ctrip sight page loaded was a different Ningbo waterfall, so verify. Semi-neglected site.

changshan-geopark.bio: A geopark of limestone landscapes around Changshan's Golden Spike, a global reference point for a geological boundary.
changshan-geopark.notes: 60 CNY comes from a 2019 provincial culture and tourism department page (search summary; page unreachable by script). Park became a UNESCO Global Geopark in April 2026 (Xinhua, per search summary) so price may have changed; Ctrip says ask the scenic area. Unverified.

taizhou-1.bio: A city museum on Aihua Road in Jiaojiang with galleries on Taizhou's history and its folk culture.
taizhou-1.notes: Free (Ctrip 'free admission'; local report says no booking needed, from a holiday notice, may be dated). Site loaded with title 台州博物馆 (only the title was visible to the fetcher).
